Randers is a Danish municipality evaluated in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. The report assesses clinical quality in the treatment of atrial fibrillation, specifically focusing on Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic strokes through anticoagulant treatment using data from the DanStroke registry [^src1]. 

As part of a comprehensive breakdown covering all 98 Danish municipalities, Randers is included to facilitate local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. Its specific performance metrics for stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients are detailed in the report's municipal data tables [^src1]. Because the available documentation for Randers in this corpus is limited to its statistical inclusion in this single table, no further historical, relational, or contextual details are available.
